models.vertebra_unet: ResNet-34 U-Net, one grayscale input, six classes (background + L1-L5)
models.hrnet_landmarks: HRNet-W32, 22 heatmaps (four corners per L1-L5 plus two S1 points)
models.s1_keypointrcnn: Torchvision Keypoint R-CNN, ResNet-50 FPN, two S1 keypoints
